scope: Retrospective development sensitivity on already evaluated data; no fresh confirmation.

exchange.contrast: original frozen exposure policy minus original frozen case policy

bootstrap.unit: M5 item, jointly across stores and days
bootstrap.pairing: Identical item multiplicities for all arms, cells, and branch comparisons.
bootstrap.conditional_on: fixed original fitted models, heads, caps, thresholds, and menu choices
bootstrap.invalid_rule: If any draw has nonpositive case-loss denominator or total exposure, report no ratio interval; never silently omit such draws.

exchange.arm_comparison: complete minus censored exchange ratio at each identical head pair
exchange.range: point-estimate minimum and maximum over all four head pairs per arm

calibration.sources: original frozen thresholds; reconstruct all five candidate masks and calibration-window metrics
calibration.margin: minimum calibration exposure coverage of Ratio minus Descending only when both feasible
calibration.other_margin: Ratio minus strongest feasible other candidate; report winning candidate and eligible count

branch.interpretation: Deterministic alternative fixed-policy comparisons; not selection probabilities or optimality.

safeguards: No claim that a fixed-policy interval includes calibration selection uncertainty
No causal conclusion about the error head from candidate margins
